title: Optimal Polynomial Stabilization of the Linearized Periodic Whitham--Boussinesq System
summary: We study the stabilization of the linearized periodic Whitham--Boussinesq system on the one-dimensional torus. We establish the well-posedness of the conservative and damped dynamics in the natural energy space and describe the spectral structure of the conservative generator, whose frequencies exhibit sublinear growth of order $|k|^{1/2}$ at high frequency. We then prove strong stability of the damped semigroup and obtain a high-frequency resolvent estimate with linear growth in the spectral parameter.
